Youngster Ben (17, 4) faces south, sight 2, so the way east keeps to row 3 past him. Bug Catcher Greg (25, 4) faces south, sight 2, over the way east along row 5. Bug Catcher James (32, 6) faces east, sight 4, over the way down at x 35..36. The others are kept out of: Lass Janice (19, 9) sees west along row 9 to x 14, Lass Sally (30, 3) west along row 3 to x 25, and Youngster Calvin (29, 10) west along row 10.
